name: Ling 3.0 Tiny (Free)
description: Ling-3.0-tiny is an efficient 7.9B-parameter MoE model with only 1.3B active parameters per token. It is designed for responsive AI agents, reliable instruction following, and natural multi-turn conversations. The model features a 256K context window, native function calling, prompt caching, and switchable Thinking and Instant modes. It supports long-context, tool-using workflows with lower active-compute requirements.
